configuration.warmup_scope: separate process before measurements; fresh solver on every run

license_policy.name: current_size_limited_installations
license_policy.note: Policy skips are declarations, not observed solve outcomes. CP Optimizer is attempted.

measurement_notes: total_s = build_s + init_s + solve_s + post_s; excludes imports, statistics, IPC and cleanup.
process_wall_s includes process setup and cleanup. The 30s default solve budget is separate from setup/finalize.
solve_s is API-call time, including model transfer when applicable; it is not pure engine time.
No time is set to zero for LICENSE_LIMIT. Unknown unfinished timings stay empty.
Exclude warmup.csv and LICENSE_LIMIT from timing statistics. Report SAT/UNKNOWN/ERROR and solved counts alongside medians.
UNKNOWN solve_timeout is censored; do not replace its missing solve_s/total_s with 30 or mix setup_timeout into solve timeouts.
CP constraints, MIP constraints and SAT clauses are different quantities.
CPU name and RAM GB in reported_* fields are user supplied. Peak memory is not measured.
Source hashes record the local files actually used. No pilot results are copied into this run.

statistical_convention: Five repetitions of the same N and seed; descriptive statistics, not independent puzzle instances. Quartiles: linear interpolation (type 7). Timings in seconds.
